groups.title: Real Estate Product
groups.meta: 17 mobile devs (VN, Egypt, Thailand) · Client: Saudi Arabia
groups.stack: Flutter, Modular Feature-Based Clean Architecture, Melos Monorepo, BLoC, Scrum, Kanban
bullets: Built and maintained features for a Saudi Arabian government client's real estate product with 10M+ users; analysed BRDs with BA, backend and QC, agreed APIs, estimated tasks and demoed every epic to the client.
Built and maintained the design system library; took part in peer code reviews.
Embedded Unity in Flutter for an in-app metaverse of buildings and events; integrated third-party SDKs.
Reduced app size from 200MB to 90MB and raised key screens from 30–40 FPS to a steady 60; optimised data-layer caching and migrated state management from Stream to BLoC.
Implemented SSL pinning and set up Adjust deferred deep links.

groups.title: Private Jet App
groups.stack: React Native, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, Reanimated, Jest, RNTL, Clean Architecture, Scrum

Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines with Fastlane and a self-hosted GitLab Runner on a Mac mini.

groups.title: SiteLog – Site Inspection App
groups.stack: Swift, SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency, SwiftData, Clean Architecture, MVVM, Factory, Swift Testing
bullets: Built an offline-first iOS app for site supervisors to record site conditions and export a signed PDF inspection report.
Built a background URLSession upload engine with S3 multipart uploads that survives suspension, termination and network loss for multi-GB sessions.
Made captures tamper-evident with SHA-256 hashes, a separate vector markup layer, an audit log and Keychain-held keys; added biometric and passcode lock.

Built PDFKit floor plans with pins, photo markup and stamps, checklists and BLE meter readings; multi-device sync, realtime WebSocket progress, push and deep links; CI/CD with Fastlane and TestFlight.
briefBullets: Built an offline-first iOS app for site inspections that exports a signed PDF report.
Built a background upload engine (S3 multipart) that survives app kill and network loss.
Made captures tamper-evident: SHA-256, markup layer, audit log, Keychain; biometric/passcode lock.
Built floor plans, markup, checklists, BLE meters, sync, realtime, push, deep links; Fastlane CI/CD.

groups.title: Warehouse App for Handheld Devices
groups.stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Clean Architecture
bullets: Built a warehouse management app for Unitech HT300/HT330 barcode devices, end to end.
Integrated the hardware scanner for live barcode capture; synced receipt, dispatch and inventory.

Built an offline-first data layer with periodic sync, so the floor kept working without a network; agreed barcode formats across teams; set up kiosk mode, auto-launch on boot and a private Play release.
